purpose: Autonomous gap find for INFERENCE (not PQ dispatch).

gaps.why: Combat doctrine concentration → same engagement pattern.
gaps.how: Wire more doctrines into live enemy defs used by directors/spawns.

gaps.why: Few ship defs → progression and traffic feel sparse.
gaps.how: New ship def + role kit or traffic presentation identity.

gaps.why: Hostile AI behaviors look samey when few archetypes cover the roster.
gaps.how: Add or rework enemy types with distinct aiArchetype + combatDoctrineId + silhouette, not only HP/dmg.

gaps.why: Shared silhouettes/hulls make factions read as recolors.
gaps.how: Distinct silhouette or wholeship presentation per role family.

gaps.why: Few job graphs → world work looks like one loop with labels.
gaps.how: New jobKind with distinct phase graph + Ceres (or sector) cast wiring.

gaps.why: Authored pocket cast uses few jobKinds → empty industrial feel.
gaps.how: More actorSlots with real jobKinds and targets in sectorActivityPockets.

gaps.why: Few hull kits or flat materials → fleet looks cheap.
gaps.how: Material/form pass on existing hull family or new kit with measureable surface response.

gaps.why: Thin weapon/tool roster limits physical mess variety.
gaps.how: New mechanically distinct weapon/module with multi-use proof.

gaps.why: Few station identities → destinations feel sparse.
gaps.how: New station or embodied place with distinct role (not menu-only).

gaps.why: Thin encounter catalog → freeflight incidents feel rare/same.
gaps.how: New interruptible encounter package on ordinary route.

gaps.why: Thin module list → builds lack agency options.
gaps.how: New module with real behavioral hook (not stat-only if possible).

agentInstructions: You are NOT waiting for a human-named unit. PQ owns that door.
Pick the highest-score gap that is not recently piled-on (see INFERENCE_LEDGER).
Invent a concrete improvement that raises unique count or lowers concentration.
Implement through live owners; prove with focused tests; re-run this script; score for that gap should not worsen and should usually improve.
